digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions CI for main branch
propositions: Push-triggered CI workflows on main with concurrency.cancel-in-progress=true cause cancelled runs to display as red X on the commit list, making a healthy main appear failed on GitHub despite Gerrit's verified gate being sufficient.

Scheduled main-health CI running every 6 hours (at staggered off-the-hour minutes 41/47/53) replacing push-on-main triggers eliminates per-commit cancellations by construction, surfacing only current-state health rather than per-commit attribution.

Last-known-green main SHA resolved from Actions API run history and bisect reproduction recipe (uv sync, make check, make test) published to GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY enable first responders to narrow regressions without waiting for scheduled ticks or reconstructing CI commands.
Non-main branch push CI (feature/** branches and topic branches) is preserved by adding main to branches-ignore lists; pre-merge Gerrit Verified gating is unchanged.

External integration and security scanning workflows (external-integration.yml, codeql.yml, terraform-drift.yml) maintain their original cadence (weekly, weekly, daily respectively) capped at once-per-day or less; gerrit-verify.yaml and reconciler workflows are unmodified.

Main-health-report job in test.yml gates nothing and is excluded from Verified-lane parity checks; workflow_dispatch is added to all six main-touched workflows so on-demand health checks work without waiting for scheduled ticks.
